summary: Picks up files from an FTP server, plain or over TLS (explicit or implicit FTPS), on a schedule, leaving files still being written for the next run.

properties.name: Port
properties.description: Server port. If empty, 990 is used for implicit FTPS and 21 otherwise.

properties.name: Encryption
properties.description: none for plain FTP, explicit for FTPS that upgrades the connection with AUTH TLS (usually port 21), or implicit for FTPS that is TLS from the start (usually port 990).

properties.name: CertificateThumbprint
properties.description: For FTPS: the SHA-256 thumbprint of the server's certificate, in hex. When set, exactly that certificate is trusted, a self-signed one included, and any other is refused before credentials are sent. When empty, the certificate must be valid.

properties.name: PassiveMode
properties.description: Passive mode, where the client opens the data connections; what almost every server behind a firewall needs. Turn off for active mode.

properties.name: TargetPath
properties.description: Remote directory to read files from.

properties.name: BatchSize
properties.description: Maximum number of files to fetch per polling batch.

properties.name: ResponseEncoding
properties.description: Encoding used to decode file contents: utf8, or base64 for binary files.

properties.name: DeleteMovesFileTo
properties.description: Folder to move a file to after it's received. If empty, the file is deleted instead.

properties.name: CheckFileExistence
properties.description: Whether to verify the file still exists before attempting to delete or move it after receiving.

properties.name: MinimumFileAgeSeconds
properties.description: Seconds a file must have gone unchanged before it is taken, so one still being uploaded is left for the next run. 0 takes every file listed.
